parameters.parameter: Disposable
Conformity to Standard for Blood Bag
Type of Blood Bag
Blood Bag with needle-stick protection device (NPD)
Blood Bag with pre- donation sampling device (PDS),
Capacity of Blood Bag
Material of Bag (Medical grade)
Blood Collection Bags should be collapsible non vented sterile containers complete with collecting tube for completely closed system to avoid the chances of contamination
Flexible Pre-sterilized and Pyrogen free
Non toxic, Non haemolytic, biocompatible material
There should be no risk of contamination and air embolism (closed system) with all leak proof seals (Disposable bags)
Slit on both sides of the bags should be enough to accommodate 5 -10 ml volume test tubes
The capacity of the bag should be enough to prevent any bollooning/ripture of the abg from the seam when it is filled up with the requisite volume of blood
Flexible kink resistant tubing
Non sticking
Transparent
Leak Proof
Length of tubing from primary bag to needle
The tubing should have same ID/segment number as that on the bag
The tubes should have multiple printed ID/segment numbers
Clamp provided for closed system
Needle Size
Ultra thin walled and straight to reduce penetration force and enable painless vein puncture
Sharp, regular and smooth margins and bevelled tip
Rust proof
Tightly fixed with hub covered with sterile guard
Hermetically sealed
The needle should not separate from the tube at any point of time, especially while removing it from the vein for donor safety
The needle must confirm to ISO 1135-3 standard
Tamper proof and should not be re-capped
Easily accessible
Type of anticoagulant present
Quantity of anticoagulant solution
Solution should be clear and colorless
There should be no discoloration of solution on storage at room temperature
Additive soultion present
Type of additive solution
Quantity of Additive solution(ml)
Anticoagulant and/or additive solution should be sterile and pyrogen free
Availability of anticoagulant/additive quality check certificate from manufacture (proof of same to be submitted to buyer)
Non-peel off
Heat sealed/ Pressure embossed label
The label should remain attached between room temperature to - 80°C with a tranparent adhesive
Date of manufacturing, date of expiry and batch number must be mentioned on each bag
Bag (Fiiled to normal capacity) shall withstand a acceleration of 5000 g for 30 min at temperature 4°C to 24°C without becoming permanently distorted
Bag (Fiiled to normal capacity) should be able to withstand temperature upto - 80°C without breakage

Individual bag packed in plastic pack and multiple bags packed in moisture proof aluminum foil (Protective dual packaging) eliminating microbial contamination on surface maintaining the contents of the bag
The supplier should ensure proper transportation of the consignment of blood bags in temperature controlled conditions (Storage temperature should not exceed 30°C)
Availability of valid drug license issued from competent authority defined under Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 (Proof of the same to be submitted to buyer on demand)
Manufacturer certifications (Proof of the same to be submitted to the buyer on demand)
Product Certifications (Proof of the same to be submitted to buyer on demand)
Each batch supplied should be accompanied with quality assurance test report from NABL approved lab/any lab approved fron govt of India as well as in house lab

Biocompatibility of the material of the product must certified by the manufacturer and be supported by the test reports of cell culture cytotoxicity, hemolysis, systemic infections, sensitization, Inra-cutaneous injection, pyrogen test and Sterility

Submission of manufacturer's documented evidence of biochemical parameters of blood stored in CPDA/CPDA- 1/CPD-SAGM containing DEHP plasticized PVC blood bags manufactured by the company on 28th/35th/42nd day of storage
Shelf Life from the date of manufacture (in months)
Stability report from a recogniozed laboratory must be submitted to the buyer at the time of supply
The product should have atleast 3/4 of the total shelf life at the time of dispatch to the consignee
